description: This file defines a Drupal class 'ConfigTranslationEntityListBuilder' responsible for building and rendering a list of configuration translation entities, including filtering, sorting, and operations specific to translation UI.

classes.name: ConfigTranslationEntityListBuilder
classes.description: A list builder class for configuration translation entities, providing filtering, sorting, and operation customization for translation management.

methods.name: getFilterLabels
methods.description: Returns user-facing strings for the filter input placeholder and description.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Builds the render array for the list, including filters, table attributes, and attached libraries.

methods.name: buildRow
methods.description: Builds a table row for a given entity, adding label data and CSS classes.

methods.name: buildHeader
methods.description: Builds the table header with a 'Label' column.

methods.name: getOperations
methods.description: Returns available operations for an entity, filtering to only show 'translate'.

methods.name: sortRows
methods.description: Sorts table rows based on the 'label' field.

methods.name: sortRowsMultiple
methods.description: Helper method to sort rows by multiple keys recursively.

methods.name: setMapperDefinition
methods.description: Placeholder method for setting mapper definitions, currently returns $this.
